sentences.text: 3. This is a second petition filed on behalf of the accused applicant challenging the impugned proceedings.

Earlier one accused, namely, Rajendra Singh had approached this Court by filing Application U/s 482 No. 15657 of 2009 [Rajendra Singh Vs. State of U.P. and Another] and some interim order was passed on that application and the proceedings were kept in abeyance.

entities.text: Rajendra Singh Vs. State of U.P. and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The interim order was being enjoyed for 11 long years and therefore, nobody was appearing to press that petition which was ultimately dismissed for non-prosecution on 26.11.2021.

The order dated 26.11.2021 reads as under:

entities.text: Keshav Deo Chaturvedi vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: "List has been revised.
None present on behalf of the applicant to press the present application.
Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent is present.
The present application is of the year 2009.
More than 11 years have already been elapsed.
It appears that by efflux of time, either the parties have lost their interest or the matter has become infructuous.
In view thereof, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed for want of prosecution.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

In case, if cause of action still survives, then applicant may approach this Court to recall this order."
4.

Once the accused, namely, Keshav Deo (Chaturvedi) had approached this Court by filing a writ petition being Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 13129 of 2007 challenging the F.I.R. and this Court vide order dated 14.11.2007 stayed the arrest of the accused Keshav Deo (Chaturvedi) till submission of the police report under Section 173 Cr.P.C.
5.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 13129 of 2007
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The offence was allegedly committed in the year 2005 and we are now in the year 2023.
The accused has/have obtained interim orders from this Court, as a result thereof, despite the charge sheet the proceedings could not move forward.

After the 482 Cr.P.C. application filed by the accused Rajendra Singh got dismissed, the Court had issued non bailable warrants and also the 82 proceedings against the accused and the accused applicant has filed this petition and has chosen not to appear to press this petition.
In view thereof, I find that there is no ground to interfere with the ongoing proceedings.
6. The present application is therefore rejected.
7. Trial court is directed to take every possible steps to secure the arrest of the accused and proceed with the case expeditiously and conclude the same preferably within a period of one year.
